bias.zh: 偏空 · 重回 5 日均线上方

read.en: The Nasdaq ADS rose 2.5% on Oct 21 to $143.25, trading between $139.93 and $145.96, with no 100-day average yet (73 sessions). It is above its falling 5-day average ($141.7) and below the falling 10-day ($151.5) and 30-day ($174.6). MACD has been below its signal since Sep 28 and is below zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 7 ($164.71), and RSI is 35.
read.zh: 纳斯达克 ADS 10月21日上涨 2.5%，收于 $143.25，盘中区间 $139.93–145.96；上市仅 73 个交易日，尚无 100 日均线。股价位于下行的 5 日均线（$141.7）上方，低于下行的 10 日（$151.5）和 30 日均线（$174.6）。MACD 自 9月28日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月7日起看空（$164.71），RSI 为 35。

read.en: The close reclaimed the 5-day average, now support. Resistance is $146 (Oct 15 and Oct 21 highs), then $148 (Oct 19 high) and $151.5 (10-day, Aug 24 low). Support is $141.7 (5-day), then $137.1–137.8 (Oct 15 and Oct 20 lows) and $133.8 (Aug 7 low). A close above $148 would target $151.5; a close below $137.1 would open $133.8.
read.zh: 收盘收复 5 日均线，该位置转为支撑。阻力为 $146（10月15日和 10月21日高点），其次 $148（10月19日高点）和 $151.5（10 日均线、8月24日低点）。支撑为 $141.7（5 日均线），其次 $137.1–137.8（10月15日和 10月20日低点）和 $133.8（8月7日低点）。若收盘站上 $148，下一目标看 $151.5；若收盘跌破 $137.1，将打开 $133.8。

bias.zh: 偏空 · 反弹回到 ₩125万上方

read.en: SK hynix closed at ₩1,294,000 in Seoul on Oct 21, up from ₩1,223,000, after a ₩1,254,000–1,329,000 range. It is above the falling 5-day (₩1,272,000) and below the falling 10-day (₩1,377,000), 30-day (₩1,655,467) and 100-day (₩1,889,450) and the rising 200-day (₩1,470,945). MACD has been below its signal and zero since Oct 6, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Sep 29 (₩1,441,400), and RSI is 31.

The close reclaimed ₩1.25 million (Jul 29 low, 5-day average), now support; the high stalled at the Oct 15–16 highs. Resistance is ₩1.33 million, then ₩1.40 million (Oct 14 low, 10-day average) and ₩1,441,400 (SAR). Support is ₩1.25 million, then ₩1,183,000–1,208,000 (Oct 19–20 lows) and ₩1,060,000 (Mar 18 high). A close above ₩1.33 million would target ₩1.40 million; below ₩1,183,000, ₩1,060,000.

s.en: Jul 29 low ₩1,246,000; Oct 21 low ₩1,254,000; 5-day average ₩1,272,000, reclaimed
